notes.title: Country Girl Keiko Free Content Update Now Available!
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32398519/caf00267bae8058b8e56237844375d1feb9da273.png

We're excited to announce that the free content update for Country Girl Keiko by Ota Guchi Field is now available on our website! We hope you all enjoy the free content update that will include new events and more! 

We've also enabled Steam Community Items for Country Girl Keiko which means you can now collect trading cards, backgrounds, emotes, and badges of your favorite characters!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1065940/Country_Girl_Keiko/

Country Girl Keiko trailer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I9TP-whvIU8

Once again we want to thank you for all of your support and we hope you'll enjoy our upcoming releases!
